cohort: Antenatal women who had a negative second trimester anomaly screening and subsequently a newly detected fetal anomaly in the routine third trimester ultrasound were included.
finding: The incidence of congenital anomalies newly detected in the third trimester was 0.7% (110 cases in 15,560 deliveries), with the majority being urogenital (32.7%) followed by cardiovascular (21.8%) anomalies.
